goal: Allow separate executables like an isolated wallet to access chain state and submit transactions over IPC
Let external processes register chain notification handlers and control the node via a socket
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now as nothing invalidates it
agreement: Broad interest in running wallets, dashboards, and indexes out-of-process over sockets
Unaddressed objection: node aborts if remote notification client raises an error (xyzconstant)
Unaddressed objection: node crashes on getBlockHash for heights past the chain tip (zaidmstrr)
Tested with a Rust wallet proof-of-concept and an Electrs IPC demo (darosior, Sjors)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it unblocks running the wallet in an independent process in #10102
Enables external indexes and standalone tools to query chain state and receive notifications over sockets
